APPROVE. The loop body is split into `MergeReport` and `AddBranchTotals` with identical logic, including partial branch totals surviving an `IOException` and `continue` becoming an equivalent `return`, so `GatherLcov` drops well below 15 and the `CHA0004` suppression stays scoped to the same catch.

I only reviewed the diff and did not build it, so I'm assuming `found`/`hit` are `long` locals, `rows` is a `Dictionary<string, FileCoverage>`, and the new method names don't collide with existing ones.
